ExampleDefinition.ToolTipDescription: Demonstrates how to create a Polar Uniform Heatmap for visualizing ultrasound data using SciChart.
ExampleDefinition.Description:
This example demonstrates how to construct a sector-shaped polar uniform heatmap using SciChart to visualize ultrasound diagnostic data. The sector view is achieved by applying a large VisibleRange to the Angular Axis, which compresses the heatmap into a sector. A rotation angle is applied to position the heatmap on the lower side of the chart. Finally, a custom WPF behavior is used to scale and reposition the polar plot within the viewport whenever the chart is resized.
[b]Data Input[/b] The UniformHeatmapDataSeries class accepts a 2D array of numerical ultrasound data.
[b]Customizable Color Mapping[/b] A user-defined color map is applied to translate data values into visually distinct colors. This enables intuitive interpretation of gradients, peaks, and troughs within the dataset.
[b]Interactive Features[/b] This example does not support standard zooming or panning features due to constraints imposed by customizations of the polar chart layout. However, custom interactions can still be implemented via the ChartModifier API.
